name: CyberOne
summary: Xiaomi's first bipedal humanoid, revealed in August 2022 alongside its phones. CyberOne uses in-house high-torque joint motors, walks, gestures, and is pitched around emotion and environment recognition. It was a statement of intent from a major consumer-electronics company more than a product.
notable: First humanoid from a large consumer-electronics brand in the current wave
In-house joint actuators shared with Xiaomi's quadruped work
